implementation.name: OpenModelica OMEdit simulation environment
implementation.version_scope: Documentation as checked on 2026-10-13; no latest-version claim.

fit.text: Equation-based models of connected physical systems.

prerequisites.text: Learn equations, continuous variables and simulation setup.

execution.text: OMEdit checks and simulates a selected Modelica model.

behavior.text: Equations describe relationships; the tool produces a numerical simulation.

tooling.text: The environment supplies model browsing, a text editor and result plotting.

maintenance.text: Check the selected tool and library version when sharing simulation models.

costs.text: OpenModelica uses OSMC licensing with component-specific terms; Modelica libraries have separate licenses.

example.run_instructions: Load Ramp.mo in OMEdit, select Ramp, check the model and simulate from time 0 to 1; plot x.
example.expected_result: The modeled x rises from 0 to approximately 1; numerical output depends on solver settings.

execution.text: gm2 compiles and links .mod files into a native executable.
